description.zh: 告警规则ID，您可以在ListPrometheusAlertRules API接口的返回数据中查看。
description.en: The ID of the alert rule. You can call the ListPrometheusAlertRules operation to query the ID of the alert rule.
The name of the alert rule.

description.zh: 注释JSON串。需要设置注释的Name和Value。
description.en: The annotations that are described in a JSON string. You must specify the name and value of each annotation.
The ID of the notification policy. This parameter is required if the NotifyType parameter is set to `DISPATCH_RULE`.

description.zh: 持续时间，范围在1m~1440m，单位为分钟。
description.en: The duration. The value ranges from 1 to 1440 minutes.

description.zh: 告警表达式，需要使用PromQL语句。
description.en: The expression of the alert rule. The expression must follow the PromQL syntax.

description.zh: 标签JSON串。需要设置标签的Name和Value。
description.en: The tags that are described in a JSON string. You must specify the name and value of each tag.

description.zh: 告警消息，支持按照{{$labels.xxx}}格式来引用标签。
description.en: The alert message. Tags can be referenced in the {{$labels.xxx}} format.

description.zh:
通知类型， 取值：

- `ALERT_MANAGER`：通过告警运维中心通知。
- `DISPATCH_RULE`：指定通知策略进行通知。
description.en:
The method that is used to send alert notifications. Valid values:

- `ALERT_MANAGER`: Alert notifications are sent by Operation Center. This is the default value.
- `DISPATCH_RULE`: Alert notifications are sent based on the specified notification policy.
The type of the alert rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-prometheus-alert-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --alert-name Prometheus_Alert --cluster-id c0bad479465464e1d8c1e641b0afb0000 --type 'Kubernetes组件告警' --notify-type ALERT_MANAGER --dispatch-rule-id 10282 --expression 100_0_sum_rate_container_cpu_usage_seconds_total_1m_by_pod_name_/_sum_label_replace_kube_pod_container_resource_limits_cpu_cores,_pod_name_,_1_,_pod_,_.0_by_pod_name_75 --duration 1 --message 'labels.pod_name_CPU使用率大于80%，当前值_value_%' --labels Value_:_critical_,_Name_:_severity --annotations Value_:_xxx_,_Name_:_description --alert-id 3888704 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
